svg.title: Youssef & Maii - Monogram with botanical sprigs (crest)
svg.desc: Monogram flanked by botanical sprigs, as on cups and invitation. Master scale: 80 mm width (scalable). | FOIL_GOLD layer = spot colour for metallic foil (display colour #A37A4E). FINAL DIELINE, PRINTABLE AREA, SCALE, BLEED AND SAFE AREA MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE MANUFACTURER'S TEMPLATE BEFORE PRODUCTION.
